nominees.name: JB Pritzker
nominees.role: Democratic incumbent governor seeking a third term
team: Christian Mitchell, former deputy governor and former state representative, 'would help execute the agenda' (Capitol News Illinois).

positions.stance: Balance the annual operating budget and chip away at the structural deficit; touts 12 credit upgrades since taking office.
Fully implement universal preschool in 2027 or 2028; says lawmakers can raise K-12 funding without reforming the EBF law (adds $350 million a year).
Address data centers, AI and utility bills; attract more nuclear power; AI cabinet created by executive order; says Congress should lead AI regulation.
Still supports a graduated income tax but leaves the proposal to lawmakers.

policyShifts.shift: Regulation of data centers possible in the mid-November veto session; AI cabinet set up by executive order.

impediments.title: Structural deficit
impediments.detail: Budget growth from $38.5 billion (FY2019) to $55.9 billion (this year's plan) is the opposition's line of attack.

impediments.title: School-funding pressure
impediments.detail: Teacher unions want more than the $350 million a year EBF adds.

insights: Third-term continuity; Christian Mitchell is the named executor of the agenda (role not announced).
The mid-November veto session is the first policy venue (data centers).
